gmcm.title: Simple Location Display
gmcm.description: Settings for the Simple Location Display mod
gmcm.enable.name: Enable Mod
gmcm.enable.tooltip: Show location popups when entering new areas
gmcm.duration.name: Notification Duration (ms)
gmcm.duration.tooltip: How long the location popup stays on screen (in milliseconds)
gmcm.saveload.name: Show on Save Load
gmcm.saveload.tooltip: Show the current location when you load a save, not only when warping
gmcm.debug.name: Enable Debug Logging
gmcm.debug.tooltip: Enable verbose debug logging for this mod
gmcm.zero.name: Show Level 0 as 'L0'
gmcm.zero.tooltip: If off, level 0 of a dungeon shows only the base location name
